name: subagent-kit
description: Scoper (Haiku), implementer (Sonnet), reviewer (Sonnet, Opus for risky changes) and shipper (Haiku) subagents, with rules for when the main session delegates to them, an /issue skill that works a GitHub issue through to a PR (or a queue of issues through to a gh-stack stack of PRs), a /grill skill that interviews you about a plan and publishes it as issues, a /next skill that reports what is ready, in flight, blocked and waiting, a /repo-init skill that sets up a repository's labels, merge settings and issue auto-close workflow, and a /worktree-include skill that writes .worktreeinclude
